description: The plot illustrates the relationship between training time and loss for two different models, comparing their performance over time. The x-axis represents training time in seconds, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 250,000, marked at intervals of 50,000. The y-axis represents loss, also on a linear scale, spanning from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. Two lines are shown: one in purple with triangle markers and a solid line style, labeled "Vanilla", and another in red with circular markers and a solid line style. The purple "Vanilla" line starts at approximately 2.74 loss at 0 seconds and decreases to around 2.48 loss at 250,000 seconds. The red line begins at about 2.72 loss at 0 seconds and drops to roughly 2.46 loss at 250,000 seconds. Both lines exhibit a declining trend throughout the training time, with the red line consistently below the purple line, indicating lower loss values across the entire training period.
